methodology: Only books explicitly named in public FEUP/SIGARRA course bibliographies are classified as FEUP-adopted.

Official publisher, author, project, or institutional pages establish identity, legal access, and licences separately from FEUP adoption.
Random PDF mirrors and copies with unclear authorization are excluded.

2026-10-01 local collection: local artifacts are indexed by id, SHA-256 and byte length; identity and edition checks are separate from adopted bibliography and reuse rights. Exact duplicates become private aliases without deleting originals.
